zh.explain: 在外在家谋事都要慢慢来，只怕过分着急会引起太多忧虑，招来麻烦。其结果必定如鸟儿飞进罗网里，摆脱困境要多少时日也未可知。
divination: 保持原有的正常状态，随机缘变化而变化，以等待贵人出现。
如果询问诸般事情的吉凶，则一定要迟稳，不可急躁冒进。
items: 疾病难康复，需长期作战
zh.summary: 此卦守旧随缘之象。所祈求之事不太如意，有凶险之兆。

verse: Delay the journey to seek your fortune,
Haste may breed grief and follies.
Like a bird which has fallen into a waiting net,
To escape will take much time.
interpretation: Remain and wait for your time and help from others.
The advice is all affairs will be late in coming to fruition.
meaning: Stay where you are and be content with what you have.
Situation is ominous and things are not in your favor.
en.explain: Take your time to make plans at all places as haste may give rise to much worries and troubles. The result will certainly be like a bird which has flown into a waiting net,  not knowing how long it will take to be freed from its predicament.
divination: Maintain the normal state that you originally have, change when the opportunity comes, wait for a benefactor to appear. If you are asking about the good or bad of things, then you must be patient, do not be rash and act prematurely.
items: Don't act rashly, keep the status quo
The results are not as good as expected, work harder
Difficult to recover, requires a long-term battle
Pray quickly for blessings & do good
